Studying at the University of Vienna
If you want to help shape the future with your ideas and are looking for more than just a place to study, then you've come to the right place at our top 100 university: Whether you're interested in a bachelor's or diploma programme, a master's, doctorate, or PhD, the University of Vienna offers a wide range of 185 programs. We also offer numerous postgraduate programmes and international exchange programmes.
©
Ian Ehm

Further education at the University of Vienna
Lifelong learning is a topic close to our hearts. We educate people and accompany them on their personal career path. The numerous university continuing education and training programmes and certificate programmes offered at the Postgraduate Center of the University of Vienna are research-based and practice-oriented at the same time.
Explore the wide range on offer.
Discover further education now
©
derknopfdruecker.com
To top
Career start and development
Whether you are exploring career options or applying for jobs, Career Center, the careers service of the University of Vienna, supports you as you take your first steps into professional life – with individual advice, practice-oriented workshops, eye-opening webinars and plenty of know-how.
At career and networking events, you will have the opportunity to meet employers in person and make your first connections.
Let us take the next step together.
Curious? Visit the Career Center
